[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] '''Tenric''' was a security [[Inspector/Legends|inspector]] assigned to the [[Rantine Space Station/Legends|Rantine Space Station]].

==Biography==
Tenric and a group of spaceport security guards performed an inspection on a ship owned by a pair of spacers. He discovered a large crate that they had been hired by [[Marg Sonat]] to transport to [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]]. After discovering contraband, he took the spacers into custody and transported them to the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] ''[[Retribution (Imperial-class)|Retribution]]'' and brought them before [[Governor/Legends|Imperial Governor]] [[Lobax Resuun|Ressuun]]. The governor coerced the spacers into join Tenric on a mission to the luxury cruiser ''[[Stellar Mermaid]]'' to eliminate a dangerous criminal enterprise operating in the sector.<ref name="AB" />

During the journey, a distress signal was detected and Tenric insisted on investigating per legal protocols. Upon their arrival at Kwenn Space Station, Tenric started an investigation to figure out what was going on.<ref name="AB" />

==Personality and traits==
Tenric was impatient and devoted to his work.<ref name="AB" />
